correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the proof for real n>=2, t>0. A norming sign vector sigma of midpoint m gives ((N(m+d)^2+N(m-d)^2)/2−N(m)^2)>=<sigma,d>^2+t||d||_2^2. Splitting positive/negative signed coordinates into a,b counts and sums A,B, Cauchy–Schwarz gives ||d||_2²>=A²/a+B²/b. AM–GM on A/B optimizes quotient to (sqrt((1+t/a)(1+t/b))−1)/(sqrt(...)+1), minimized with all n supports and balanced p=floor(n/2),q=ceil(n/2). Explicit d=(r/p repeated p, −1/q repeated q), r=sqrt((1+t/q)/(1+t/p)), v=|d|, yields equal ||kv±d||²=(k²+c)||d||² for k>=1; scaling gives exact Day modulus lower-envelope equality for eps<=eps*=2/sqrt(1+c). For eps>eps*, equality in sign norm estimates requires coordinatewise |m|>=|d|, contradicting required N(m)^2=1-c eps²/4<N(d)^2=eps²/4; compactness yields strict gap up to eps=2. Checked endpoint epsilon=0/2 and n even/odd. Independently evaluated four explicit equality witnesses (n,t)=(3,1),(3,7),(4,2),(5,0.3), all quadratic defects matching c to <1e-14. Sampling is not proof; analytic minimization covers all parameters.
